import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly associated features (p < 0.01)
    p_values = [stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                               feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])[1] 
                for fid in feats.ids]
    
    significant = [fid for fid, p in zip(feats.ids, p_values) if p < 0.01]
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if not significant:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build correlation matrix for significant features
    X_sig = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in significant]]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X_sig.T)
    
    # Cluster features based on correlation
    clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=1, affinity='precomputed', 
                                   random_state=0).fit(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    cluster_labels = clustering.labels_
    
    # Select the largest cluster as our module
    module_features = [significant[i] for i in range(len(significant)) 
                       if cluster_labels[i] == np.bincount(cluster_labels).argmax()]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlation > 0.9)
    unique_module = []
    for fid in module_features:
        is_duplicate = any(abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)], 
                                          feats.x[:, feats.column(other_fid)])[0,1]) > 0.9 
                          for other_fid in unique_module)
        if not is_duplicate:
            unique_module.append(fid)
    
    # If no module found, return empty design
    if len(unique_module) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score using first two features' loadings
    weights = {}
    for fid in unique_module[:2]:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        # Weight by effect size (difference in means between classes)
        mean_y1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx])
        mean_y0 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])
        weights[fid] = mean_y1 - mean_y0
    
    # Normalize weights
    total_weight = sum(abs(w) for w in weights.values())
    if total_weight > 0:
        weights = {k: v/total_weight for k, v in weights.items()}
    
    # Return design with module features and their weighted score
    # Ensure at most 4 drivers
    drivers = tuple(unique_module[:4])
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=tuple(unique_module),
        products=(),
        loadings=weights
    )
